solutionSql:
SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers c
WHERE c.region IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM shipments s
    WHERE s.customer_id = c.id
  )
ORDER BY c.id ASC;
notes: Only customer 7 meets both conditions. Customer 8 also has no shipments, but its region is South, so it is excluded. NOT EXISTS is the clear form for the no-shipments condition.
